problem: Hosted 2026-11-24..26: every trading persona's envelope publication ended consultation_operator (risk_persona_requires_operator / escalate memo) and _publish only reported the state; nothing was queued for an operator, so the publication never progressed.

services/persona/pool_autonomy_cycle.py: _publish (L222-273): when the envelope_publication consultation state is 'operator' and the port exposes publication_operator_decision, the new _publication_operator_gate decides; other states keep today's behaviour

_publication_operator_gate (L278-310): read the operator decision; absent -> queue it once and stay consultation_operator (operator_decision.status=queued); proposed/reviewed -> consultation_operator with status=awaiting_operator; approved/executed -> publish the current pool version (same live membership as the escalated consultation) with operator_decision_id + consultation_request_id on the publication receipt; rejected/canceled/superseded -> status operator_rejected with the operator's note as reason, nothing published so the previous envelope keeps running; read/queue failure -> held with read_failed/queue_failed, never treated as approval
apply_to_packet: operator_rejected is added to the packet audit_refs with its reason
services/persona/pool_publish_port.py: envelope_publication_consultation: the operator/verified/pending results now carry pool_version (the version the panel reviewed) and the operator result carries the panel memo_id; the dead-letter retries-exhausted operator result binds the consultation's own pool version instead of today's (so the operator decision does not change id with each daily re-weight)

publication_operator_decision_id (L120): 'pool-publication-op-' + sha256(consultation decision_id)[:24]; the consultation decision_id binds tenant, persona, live-membership digest and pool version (envelope_publication_requirement)

publication_operator_decision (L123-147): GET /api/evolution/proposals/{id} on the evolution owner; 404 -> None; a record whose tenant, persona or metadata.consultation_decision_id does not match raises operator_decision_binding_mismatch (fails closed)

queue_publication_operator_decision (L149-): POST /api/evolution/proposals, the same governance queue and body shape as trial admission's queue_operator_decision (action_type flag_for_review, target persona, created_by persona-svc/evolution_controller); metadata carries reason, pool_version, membership_digest, consultation_decision_id/request_id/memo_id, paper_only; 409 (occupied id) -> already_queued

residual_risks: Evolution single-active rule (services/control-plane/governance/evolution_decision.py:1550) allows one active (proposed/reviewed/approved) decision per tenant + target_type persona + persona id. If a trial-admission operator decision for the same persona is still active, the publication POST is refused by the owner; the cycle records operator_decision.status=queue_failed with the owner's reason and retries next cycle. Same constraint the trial-admission path already has.
An approved flag_for_review decision stays active until the evolution dispatch path executes it; this task does not change that owner behaviour.
review_independence: Reviewer Antigravity (different model family from owner Claude).
